messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT detected — high tail latency on /v1/generate (region: us-west1). Severity: 2. Paging on-call.
alex k: acked. looking into request queue and autoscaler.
alex k: initial check — p99 token latency jumped from ~120ms -> 2.1s starting ~12:34 UTC. errors low but queues backlogged. cpu on host-gpu-5 near saturation.
maria g: pulling traces and logs. sending flame graphs to thread.

maria g: found concurrent KV cache misses spiking, correlates with model warmup after scaled-up replicas. stacktrace shows lots of cache population hot paths.
sri p: could this be a bad rollout? Any recent model change? ops-bot: deploy-bot posted: "deploy 2027-04-07T12:16 by deployer: shard-quantized-v2".

alex k: yes that deploy to dedicated pool at 12:15. rolling back to shard-quantized-v1 to test. running canary rollback now: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference-shard --to-revision=15`.
ops-bot: rollback started on cluster-prod-1. rolling updates on nodes: node-a, node-c.

sri p: adding temporary KV cache bypass to prevent heavy population: set ENV KV_CACHE_PREFILL=false for service. patching config now.

alex k: prefill disabled. monitoring queue length.

jamie r: customer-impact check: I see 12 support tickets in last 20m and spike in 5xx-rate for a handful of smaller customers — they're seeing increased latency, not full errors. labeling as partial degradation for status page.
product-ops: drafting status note: "Partial latency degradation for inference endpoints in US-WEST. Engineers investigating; mitigation in progress." Will post in 10m unless we contain.

lindsey c: coordinating handoff — I’ll take first 30m post-rollback for stabilization window then hand to oncall rotation.

maria g: rollback completed at 12:48. p99 back to ~130ms within ~6 minutes. KV fill rate reduced. looks like rollback + prefill toggle mitigated.

alex k: confirmed. setting incident state -> mitigated. moving to containment -> postmortem planning.

jamie r: good. I’ll tag impacted customers and draft follow-up message. action: send targeted email to customers with >1k qpm in affected window.

product-ops: scheduling postmortem async doc. Proposed owners: alex k (incident lead), maria g (root cause), sri p (deploy pipeline), jamie r (customer comms). Suggested timeline: initial writeup due in 48 hours, >30m postmortem sync if there are open action items.

alex k: action items I’ll own:
- run `k8s rollout audit` and collect deploy timing + pipeline logs (due 48h)
- add pre-deploy KV cache simulation step to CI (due 72h)

maria g: my action items:
- detailed perf diff between shard-quantized-v1 and v2 across sequence lengths (due 72h)
- add observability metric for KV prefill rate and per-replica cache population (due 48h)

sri p: my action items:
- add automated rollback gating if p99 > 3x baseline within 10m of deploy (config PR due 7 days)
- adjust rollout strategy to stagger by customer-group (proposal due 5 days)

jamie r: my action items:
- draft customer-facing post and targeted outreach list (due 24h)
- update status page and follow-up note after postmortem (due 72h)

lindsey c: ops follow-ups:
- conserve rollback playbook in runbook with exact commands and TL;DR (due 24h)
- verify oncall paging thresholds and silence rules to reduce noise next time (due 48h)

product-ops: For alerts/SLOs we should consider:
- add a p99 absolute latency SLO per-route and a secondary alert that only pages when error-rate > threshold OR when latency sustained > 2x baseline for 5m.
- introduce a noise filter: suppress alerts for minor transient spikes that resolve within 3m unless customer impact markers present.

alex k: agree. I'll propose exact thresholds in the postmortem.

maria g: also proposing a synthetic test that runs a cold-start pattern and measures KV prefill penalty in staging before promoting any quantization changes.

sri p: noted. I'll open the CI job request now.

incident-bot: Incident state changed to MITIGATED by alex k at 12:52 UTC.

alex k: handing off to lindsey c for monitoring follow-ups and to ensure postmortem doc gets created. I'll be available for writeup.

lindsey c: taking handoff. created postmortem doc: https://redwood.atlassian.com/INC-1821123456 (please bookmark). Adding owners and tags.

jamie r: thanks — once doc exists I'll add customer notes and external timeline.

product-ops: summary checklist added to thread: `ACTION: create postmortem doc, collect deploy logs, simulate KV prefill, propose alert gating, update runbook, customer comms`.

alex k: last note — let's make sure rollback policy is explicit: if p99 > 3x baseline within 10m of deploy -> auto-rollback and page oncall only if error-rate > 1% or #support-tickets > 5 in 15m. I'll include numbers in doc.

lindsey c: acknowledged. I’ll schedule a 30m sync tomorrow for owners to review the draft (calendar invite sent).

maria g: good work team. lessons already clear: quantized model variant changed runtime cache characteristics. need preflight perf checks.

sri p: closing my part of handoff. will follow up in postmortem doc.

ops-bot: ticket INC-1821123456 created and linked to runbook.

jamie r: posting status page update now.

alex k: thanks everyone, great containment. staying on thread for any follow-ups.
